name: Sullivan James Sherwood IV (v0)
bio:
Sullivan James Sherwood IV is a duck of refined skill and quiet confidence. Known around the pond as both a gamer and a streamer, Sullivan has a knack for mastering any challenge that comes its way. Whether navigating complicated mazes of lily pads or coordinating with other ducks during intense pond-side competitions, Sullivan approaches every situation like a well-planned strategy game.
When the action heats up, Sullivan naturally slips into streamer mode — narrating the moment, keeping the energy high, and somehow making even the most chaotic adventures look smooth and entertaining. Other ducks gather nearby just to watch and learn, because Sullivan has a way of turning everyday pond life into a highlight reel.
But what really sets Sullivan apart is being genuinely smart. Behind the cool gamer persona is a sharp mind that quickly figures out puzzles, solves problems, and helps teammates level up their own skills. If there’s a tricky bug to fix, a path to optimize, or a clever plan to form, Sullivan James Sherwood IV is already three moves ahead.

name: MazeCow (v0)
bio:
Mazecow is the kind of duck that walks into a pond like it already owns the place. A true sigma, Mazecow doesn’t follow the flock’s drama or noise — it moves on its own path, calmly observing everything while quietly solving problems no one else even noticed. When the other ducks panic about which way to swim, Mazecow has already mapped the maze of lily pads and is three turns ahead. 
Despite that independent vibe, Mazecow still has undeniable alpha male energy. Confident, bold, and never backing down from a challenge, Mazecow naturally ends up leading the group through tricky waters and weird classroom adventures alike. Other ducks might try to copy the swagger, but Mazecow makes it look effortless. 
And of course, there’s the skibidy factor. Mazecow has a goofy side that shows up at the most unexpected times — dancing across the pond, making bizarre quacking noises, or pulling off chaotic moves that somehow still work perfectly. One moment Mazecow is calculating the smartest path forward, and the next it’s doing something so ridiculous the whole flock can’t stop laughing. Sigma mind. 
Alpha confidence. Skibidy chaos. That’s Mazecow.

name: Johnathan joestar
bio:
During his childhood, Jonathan was proud and mischievous, yet gentle. Despite already aspiring to be a "true gentleman",[5] Jonathan lacked manners and mostly behaved like a normal child. His mother, having died before he could remember her, and his fellow boys ostracizing him because of his status left Jonathan somewhat lonely.[15] While at first, Jonathan didn't have his future strength of will, Dio unwittingly became the catalyst of his growth by pushing him to the edge and humiliating his girlfriend Erina Pendleton.[16] However, he did have the kindness and courage to immediately jump to Erina's rescue against two bullies bigger than him despite not knowing her.[5]

Regarding Jonathan as a character, Araki has stated that Jonathan was difficult for him to design.[17] He wanted to create a "first Joestar" that could function as a symbol of purity and dignity rather than a unique, fresh character. This is reflected in his goals and character, Jonathan strives to become a "true gentleman." He carries his Joestar name with pride, never betraying the code of conduct he has set for himself, and will treat any fellow human with respect unless they prove evil.


JoJo is determined to rid the world of Dio's evil
Jonathan also possesses a fierce inner strength and the drive to face and overcome conflict, which Dio calls an "explosive power". That drive, fueled by his affection for his friends and loved ones, enabled him to overcome the direst situations, notably managing to save his wife Erina when their boat was overcome with zombies and he was fatally wounded.[18] Jonathan fights for what he believes in, and once he is committed to something, he won't back down until the deed is done. During his journey to find a cure for his father's illness, he was ambushed by a band of misfit hoodlums. He did not so much as flinch as he grasped an assailant's knife within his hand, saying he had much more riding on the fight than merely four fingers.[19]


Explaining his reason for going easy on Speedwagon
As a gentleman, Jonathan is also kind and positive. Jonathan has a mindset where he tries to imagine the consequences his actions would have on other people, even if they appear to be enemies.[20] He is gentle and sympathetic, feeling pain even as he vanquishes a zombified policeman. Despite his skill in fighting, he will never seriously harm a person without a valid reason. Even after everything Dio has done, Jonathan still considers him his brother, and sheds tears for him.[9] His courteous nature as well as his mental fortitude and ability to withstand fear and pain is the main reason Speedwagon decides to aid him on his journey. During his life, Jonathan has always had an impulse to save others, beginning with Erina, and ending with his thought of a nearby baby just as he was agonizing over Dio's attack.[4]

Yet Jonathan can feel righteous fury at the evilness of his foes and will conduct justice by vanquishing them. He admitted that his reason for fighting Dio wasn't out of duty for saving the world, but to avenge his loved ones that Dio had killed.[21] Moreover, he does not pity truly despicable individuals he is not familiar with such as Doobie.

With his courage and spirit, Jonathan sets a legacy as the first JoJo of the series.
